headline: Denée Benton Wants to Come Back as ‘a Detached, Chaotic Gemini’
context: “I feel like that’s what Steve Lacy gives,” the “Gilded Age” actor says. She’s a fan of his new album, as well as Zora Neale Hurston and nude beaches.
